title: Localize your screen with Fingerprint: no more image or text references
description:
Which screen is the device on? With Localize, one click tells you. Localize compares the live picture with every screen of the app's map and names the right one with a confidence score, ruling the others out. If the screen isn't on the map, it says so and never guesses. 
Behind it is the Fingerprint: a visual signature VirtualPyTest makes on its own from each screen's screenshot, covering the whole screen, its key areas and its title. 
That means no image or text reference to create or maintain for each screen: one screenshot is enough. It's also what lets an AI exploring an app tell a new screen from one it already knows.

Open source & free.
